title: Chinese EV Makers GAC, Geely, and Leapmotor Ace Euro NCAP Safety Tests
detail: Chinese EV manufacturers GAC, Geely, and Leapmotor achieved top scores in Euro NCAP safety testing, countering widespread perceptions that Chinese EVs lag behind European competitors on safety standards. The results mark a significant milestone in Chinese automakers' push into European markets.
